area: testbed hardening: cycle 162's Python-floor guard missed scripts/ and could not detect a new folder

find.report_claim: cycle 162 introduced tests/test_python_floor.py to enforce the README's 'Python 3.10+' promise on the shooter side
find.live_evidence: the guard listed shooter/, tests/ and play.py explicitly and never scanned scripts/ -- six shipped files, capture.py alone over 100 kB, all documented in the README
find.consumer_evidence: the coverage test compared that list with a second hardcoded folder list, so a brand-new top-level package escaped both; a probe with tools/probe.py (containing 'from typing import Self') passed all 8 tests

read: scripts/*.py (audio_probe, capture, keystone_manifest_asset_repro, play_run, record_bot, soak)
the README's mention of capture/soak/play_run as shipped tooling
killed: adding 'scripts' to the existing hardcoded list: it fixes today's gap and leaves the next folder unguarded
asserting `len(SOURCES) >= 150` alone: a count does not say which files are missing
walking the whole repo without an ignore list: .git, __pycache__, .venv and evidence folders would produce noise and false failures
analyze.survivor: derive SOURCES from a filesystem walk with an explicit ignore list, and make the coverage test compare that walk against itself so any unlisted Python file fails by name

fix.shooter: tests/test_python_floor.py replaces the hardcoded SOURCES list with _shipped_python_files(), a REPO.rglob walk that skips .git, .aikit, __pycache__, .pytest_cache, saves, evidence, assets, LICENSES, .venv, venv, node_modules, dist and build; the coverage test now asserts the scan equals the walk, so a new folder is covered the moment it appears

shooter.scripts_audit: all six scripts were scanned explicitly before the fix and are currently clean (no PEP 695, no post-3.10 stdlib), so the gap was latent rather than active
shooter.mutation: creating tools/probe.py with 'from typing import Self' initially PASSED all 8 tests, which exposed the hardcoded-list weakness; after deriving SOURCES from the walk the same file fails the floor test with 'probe.py:1 imports typing.Self (needs 3.11)'. The probe folder was removed and the suite returned to green.
